1.text: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after tha death of Ahab.

N Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber dat was in Samaria, N was sick: N he sent messengers, N said 2 ’em, Go, enquire of Baal-zebub tha god of Ekron whether I shall recover of dis disease.

But tha angel of tha LORD said 2 Elijah tha Tishbite, Arise, go up 2 meet tha messengers of tha king of Samaria, N say 2 ’em, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, dat y’all go 2 enquire of Baal-zebub tha god of Ekron?
Now therefore like dis says tha LORD, u will not come down from dat bed on which u r gone up, but will surely die. N Elijah departed.
N when tha messengers turned back 2 him, he said 2 ’em, Why r y’all now turned back?

N dey said 2 him, There came a man up 2 meet us, N said 2 us, Go, turn again 2 tha king dat sent u, N say 2 him, like dis says tha LORD, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, dat u send 2 enquire of Baal-zebub tha god of Ekron? therefore u will not come down from dat bed on which u r gone up, but will surely die.
N he said 2 ’em, What manner of man was he which came up 2 meet u, N told u dese words?
N dey answered him, He was an hairy man, N girt wit a girdle of leather about his loins. N he said, It is Elijah tha Tishbite.
Then tha king sent 2 him a captain of fifty wit his fifty. N he went up 2 him: N, look, he sat on tha top of an hill. N he spoke 2 him, u man of God, tha king has said, Come down.
N Elijah answered 2 tha captain of fifty, If I be a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, N consume u N ur fifty. N there came down fire from heaven, N consumed him N his fifty.
Again also he sent 2 him another captain of fifty wit his fifty. N he answered 2 him, O man of God, like dis has tha king said, Come down quickly.
N Elijah answered 2 ’em, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, N consume u N ur fifty. N tha fire of God came down from heaven, N consumed him N his fifty.

N he sent again a captain of tha third fifty wit his fifty. N tha third captain of fifty went up, N came N fell on his knees before Elijah, N besought him, N said 2 him, O man of God, I pray u, let my life, N tha life of dese fifty ur servants, be precious in ur sight.
Look, there came fire down from heaven, N burnt up tha two captains of tha former fifties wit their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in ur sight.
N tha angel of tha LORD said 2 Elijah, Go down wit him: don’t be afraid of him. N he arose, N went down wit him 2 tha king.

N he said 2 him, like dis says tha LORD, Forasmuch as u have sent messengers 2 enquire of Baal-zebub tha god of Ekron, is it not because there is no God in Israel 2 enquire of his word? therefore u will not come down off dat bed on which u r gone up, but will surely die.
So he died according 2 tha word of tha LORD which Elijah had spoken. N Jehoram reigned in his stead in tha second year of Jehoram tha son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.
Now tha rest of tha acts of Ahaziah which he did, r dey not written in tha book of tha chronicles of tha kings of Israel?

2.text: N it happened, when tha LORD would take up Elijah in2 heaven by a whirlwind, dat Elijah went wit Elisha from Gilgal.
N Elijah said 2 Elisha, Tarry here, I pray u; 4 tha LORD has sent me 2 Beth-el. N Elisha said 2 him, As tha LORD lives, N as ur soul lives, I will not leave u. So dey went down 2 Beth-el.
N tha sons of tha prophets dat were at Beth-el came forth 2 Elisha, N said 2 him, know u dat tha LORD will take away ur master from ur head 2 day? N he said, yeah, I know it; hold y’all ur peace.
N Elijah said 2 him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray u; 4 tha LORD has sent me 2 Jericho. N he said, As tha LORD lives, N as ur soul lives, I will not leave u. So dey came 2 Jericho.
N tha sons of tha prophets dat were at Jericho came 2 Elisha, N said 2 him, know u dat tha LORD will take away ur master from ur head 2 day? N he answered, yeah, I know it; hold y’all ur peace.
N Elijah said 2 him, Tarry, I pray u, here; 4 tha LORD has sent me 2 Jordan. N he said, As tha LORD lives, N as ur soul lives, I will not leave u. N dey two went on.
N fifty men of tha sons of tha prophets went, N stood 2 view afar off: N dey two stood by Jordan.
N Elijah took his mantle, N wrapped it together, N struck tha waterz, N dey were divided here N there, so dat dey two went over on dry ground.
N it happened, when dey were gone over, dat Elijah said 2 Elisha, Ask what I shall do 4 u, before I be taken away from u. N Elisha said, I pray u, let a double portion of ur spirit be upon me.
N he said, u have asked a hard thing: nevertheless, if u see me when I am taken from u, it shall be so 2 u; but if not, it shall not be so.
N it happened, as dey still went on, N talked, dat, look, there appeared a chariot of fire, N horses of fire, N parted ’em both asunder; N Elijah went up by a whirlwind in2 heaven.
N Elisha saw it, N he cried, My father, my father, tha chariot of Israel, N tha horsemen of it. N he saw him no more: N he took hold of his own clothes, N rent ’em in two pieces.
He took up also tha mantle of Elijah dat fell from him, N went back, N stood by tha bank of Jordan;
N he took tha mantle of Elijah dat fell from him, N struck tha waterz, N said, Where is tha LORD God of Elijah? N when he also had struck tha waterz, dey parted here N there: N Elisha went over.
N when tha sons of tha prophets which were 2 view at Jericho saw him, dey said, tha spirit of Elijah does rest on Elisha. N dey came 2 meet him, N bowed themselves 2 tha ground before him.

N dey said 2 him, look now, there be wit ur servants fifty strong men; let ’em go, we pray u, N seek ur master: lest maybe tha Spirit of tha LORD has taken him up, N cast him upon some mountain, or in2 some valley. N he said, y’all shall not send.
N when dey urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. dey sent therefore fifty men; N dey sought three days, but found him not.
N when dey came again 2 him, (4 he tarried at Jericho,) he said 2 ’em, Did I not say 2 u, Go not?
N tha men of tha city said 2 Elisha, look, I pray u, tha situation of dis city is pleasant, as my lord sees: but tha water is naught, N tha ground barren.
N he said, Bring me a new cruse, N put salt in it. N dey brought it 2 him.
N he went forth 2 tha spring of tha waterz, N cast tha salt in there, N said, like dis says tha LORD, I have healed dese waterz; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land.
So tha waterz were healed 2 dis day, according 2 tha sayin of Elisha which he spoke.
N he went up from thence 2 Beth-el: N as he was goin up by tha way, there came forth little children out of tha city, N mocked him, N said 2 him, Go up, u bald head; go up, u bald head.
N he turned back, N looked on ’em, N cursed ’em in tha name of tha LORD. N there came forth two she bears out of tha wood, N tare forty N two children of ’em.
N he went from thence 2 mount Carmel, N from thence he returned 2 Samaria.

3.text: Now Jehoram tha son of Ahab began 2 reign over Israel in Samaria tha eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, N reigned twelve years.
N he wrought evil in tha sight of tha LORD; but not like his father, N like his mother: 4 he put away tha image of Baal dat his father had made.
Nevertheless he cleaved 2 tha sins of Jeroboam tha son of Nebat, which made Israel 2 sin; he departed not from there.
N Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, N rendered 2 tha king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, N an hundred thousand rams, wit tha wool.
But it happened, when Ahab was dead, dat tha king of Moab rebelled against tha king of Israel.
N king Jehoram went out of Samaria tha same time, N numbered all Israel.

N he went N sent 2 Jehoshaphat tha king of Judah, sayin, tha king of Moab has rebelled against me: will u go wit me against Moab 2 battle? N he said, I will go up: I am as u r, my people as ur people, N my horses as ur horses.
N he said, Which way shall we go up? N he answered, tha way through tha wilderness of Edom.
So tha king of Israel went, N tha king of Judah, N tha king of Edom: N dey fetched a compass of seven days’ journey: N there was no water 4 tha host, N 4 tha cattle dat followed ’em.
N tha king of Israel said, Alas! dat tha LORD has called dese three kings together, 2 deliver ’em in2 tha hand of Moab!

But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of tha LORD, dat we may enquire of tha LORD by him? N one of tha king of Israel’s servants answered, Here is Elisha tha son of Shaphat, which poured water on tha hands of Elijah.
N Jehoshaphat said, tha word of tha LORD is wit him. So tha king of Israel N Jehoshaphat N tha king of Edom went down 2 him.

N Elisha said 2 tha king of Israel, What have I 2 do wit u? get u 2 tha prophets of ur father, N 2 tha prophets of ur mother. N tha king of Israel said 2 him, no: 4 tha LORD has called dese three kings together, 2 deliver ’em in2 tha hand of Moab.
N Elisha said, As tha LORD of hosts lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not dat I regard tha presence of Jehoshaphat tha king of Judah, I would not look toward u, nor see u.
But now bring me a minstrel. N it happened, when tha minstrel played, dat tha hand of tha LORD came upon him.
N he said, like dis says tha LORD, Make dis valley full of ditches.
4 like dis says tha LORD, y’all shall not see wind, neither shall y’all see rain; yet dat valley shall be filled wit water, dat y’all may drink, both y’all, N ur cattle, N ur beasts.
N dis is but a light thing in tha sight of tha LORD: he will deliver tha Moabites also in2 ur hand.
N y’all shall strike every fenced city, N every choice city, N shall fell every good tree, N stop all wells of water, N mar every good piece of land wit stones.
N it happened in tha morning, when tha food offering was offered, dat, look, there came water by tha way of Edom, N tha country was filled wit water.
N when all tha Moabites heard dat tha kings were come up 2 fight against ’em, dey gathered all dat were able 2 put on armour, N upward, N stood in tha border.
N dey rose up early in tha morning, N tha sun shone upon tha water, N tha Moabites saw tha water on tha other side as red as blood:
N dey said, dis is blood: tha kings r surely killed, N dey have struck one another: now therefore, Moab, 2 tha spoil.
N when dey came 2 tha camp of Israel, tha Israelites rose up N struck tha Moabites, so dat dey fled before ’em: but dey went forward strikin tha Moabites, even in their country.

N dey beat down tha citiez, N on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, N filled it; N dey stopped all tha wells of water, N felled all tha good trees: only in Kir-haraseth left dey tha stones of it; but tha slingers went about it, N struck it.
N when tha king of Moab saw dat tha battle was too sore 4 him, he took wit him seven hundred men dat drew swords, 2 break through even 2 tha king of Edom: but dey could not.

Then he took his eldest son dat should have reigned in his stead, N offered him 4 a burnt offering upon tha wall. N there was great indignation against Israel: N dey departed from him, N returned 2 their own land.

4.text: Now there cried a certain woman of tha wives of tha sons of tha prophets 2 Elisha, sayin, ur servant my husband is dead; N u know dat ur servant did fear tha LORD: N tha creditor is come 2 take 2 him my two sons 2 be bondmen.
N Elisha said 2 her, What shall I do 4 u? tell me, what have u in tha house? N she said, Thine handmaid has not any thing in tha house, save a pot of oil.
Then he said, Go, borrow u vessels abroad of all ur neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
N when u r come in, u will shut tha door upon u N upon ur sons, N will pour out in2 all dose vessels, N u will set aside dat which is full.
So she went from him, N shut tha door upon her N upon her sons, who brought tha vessels 2 her; N she poured out.
N it happened, when tha vessels were full, dat she said 2 her son, Bring me yet a vessel. N he said 2 her, There is not a vessel more. N tha oil stayed.
Then she came N told tha man of God. N he said, Go, sell tha oil, N pay ur debt, N live u N ur children of tha rest.
N it fell on a day, dat Elisha passed 2 Shunem, where was a great woman; N she constrained him 2 eat bread. N so it was, dat as oft as he passed by, he turned in there 2 eat bread.
N she said 2 her husband, look now, I perceive dat dis is an holy man of God, which passes by us continually.
Let us make a little chamber, I pray u, on tha wall; N let us set 4 him there a bed, N a table, N a stool, N a candlestick: N it will be, when he comes 2 us, dat he shall turn in there.
N it fell on a day, dat he came there, N he turned in2 tha chamber, N lay there.
N he said 2 Gehazi his servant, Call dis Shunammite. N when he had called her, she stood before him.

N he said 2 him, Say now 2 her, look, u have been careful 4 us wit all dis care; what is 2 be done 4 u? would u be spoken 4 2 tha king, or 2 tha captain of tha host? N she answered, I live among my own people.
N he said, What then is 2 be done 4 her? N Gehazi answered, for real she has no child, N her husband is old.
N he said, Call her. N when he had called her, she stood in tha door.
N he said, About dis season, according 2 tha time of life, u will embrace a son. N she said, no, my lord, u man of God, do not lie 2 thine handmaid.
N tha woman conceived, N bare a son at dat season dat Elisha had said 2 her, according 2 tha time of life.
N when tha child was grown, it fell on a day, dat he went out 2 his father 2 tha reapers.
N he said 2 his father, My head, my head. N he said 2 a lad, Carry him 2 his mother.
N when he had taken him, N brought him 2 his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, N then died.
N she went up, N laid him on tha bed of tha man of God, N shut tha door upon him, N went out.
N she called 2 her husband, N said, Send me, I pray u, one of tha young men, N one of tha asses, dat I may run 2 tha man of God, N come again.
N he said, so will u go 2 him 2 day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. N she said, It shall be well.
Then she saddled an ass, N said 2 her servant, Drive, N go forward; slack not ur ridin 4 me, except I bid u.
So she went N came 2 tha man of God 2 mount Carmel. N it happened, when tha man of God saw her afar off, dat he said 2 Gehazi his servant, look, yonder is dat Shunammite:
Run now, I pray u, 2 meet her, N say 2 her, Is it well wit u? is it well wit ur husband? is it well wit tha child? N she answered, It is well.

N when she came 2 tha man of God 2 tha hill, she caught him by tha feet: but Gehazi came near 2 thrust her away. N tha man of God said, Let her alone; 4 her soul is vexed within her: N tha LORD has hid it from me, N has not told me.
Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?

Then he said 2 Gehazi, Gird up ur loins, N take my staff in thine hand, N go ur way: if u meet any man, greet him not; N if any greet u, answer him not again: N lay my staff upon tha face of tha child.
N tha mother of tha child said, As tha LORD lives, N as ur soul lives, I will not leave u. N he arose, N followed her.
N Gehazi passed on before ’em, N laid tha staff upon tha face of tha child; but there was neither voice, nor hearin. so he went again 2 meet him, N told him, sayin, tha child is not awaked.
N when Elisha was come in2 tha house, look, tha child was dead, N laid upon his bed.
He went in therefore, N shut tha door upon ’em twain, N prayed 2 tha LORD.
N he went up, N lay upon tha child, N put his mouth upon his mouth, N his eyes upon his eyes, N his hands upon his hands: N he stretched himself upon tha child; N tha flesh of tha child grew warm.
Then he returned, N walked in tha house 2 N fro; N went up, N stretched himself upon him: N tha child sneezed seven times, N tha child opened his eyes.
N he called Gehazi, N said, Call dis Shunammite. So he called her. N when she was come in 2 him, he said, Take up ur son.
Then she went in, N fell at his feet, N bowed herself 2 tha ground, N took up her son, N went out.

N Elisha came again 2 Gilgal: N there was a dearth in tha land; N tha sons of tha prophets were sittin before him: N he said 2 his servant, Set on tha great pot, N seethe pottage 4 tha sons of tha prophets.
N one went out in2 tha field 2 gather herbs, N found a wild vine, N gathered of it wild gourds his lap full, N came N shred ’em in2 tha pot of pottage: 4 dey knew ’em not.
So dey poured out 4 tha men 2 eat. N it happened, as dey were eatin of tha pottage, dat dey cried out, N said, O u man of God, there is death in tha pot. N dey could not eat of it.
But he said, Then bring meal. N he cast it in2 tha pot; N he said, Pour out 4 tha people, dat dey may eat. N there was no harm in tha pot.

N there came a man from Baal-shalisha, N brought tha man of God bread of tha firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, N full ears of corn in tha husk of it. N he said, Give 2 tha people, dat dey may eat.
N his servitor said, What, should I set dis before an hundred men? He said again, Give tha people, dat dey may eat: 4 like dis says tha LORD, dey shall eat, N shall leave of it.
So he set it before ’em, N dey did eat, N left of it, according 2 tha word of tha LORD.

5.text: Now Naaman, captain of tha host of tha king of Syria, was a great man wit his master, N honourable, because by him tha LORD had given deliverance 2 Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.
N tha Syrians had gone out by companies, N had brought away captive out of tha land of Israel a little maid; N she waited on Naaman’s wife.
N she said 2 her mistress, Would God my lord were wit tha prophet dat is in Samaria! 4 he would recover him of his leprosy.
N one went in, N told his lord, sayin, like dis N like dis said tha maid dat is of tha land of Israel.
N tha king of Syria said, Go 2, go, N I will send a letter 2 tha king of Israel. N he departed, N took wit him ten talents of silver, N six thousand pieces of gold, N ten changes of clothing.
N he brought tha letter 2 tha king of Israel, sayin, Now when dis letter is come 2 u, look, I have wit it sent Naaman my servant 2 u, dat u may recover him of his leprosy.

N it happened, when tha king of Israel had read tha letter, dat he rent his clothes, N said, Am I God, 2 kill N 2 make alive, dat dis man does send 2 me 2 recover a man of his leprosy? so consider, I pray u, N see how he seeks a quarrel against me.

N it was so, when Elisha tha man of God had heard dat tha king of Israel had rent his clothes, dat he sent 2 tha king, sayin, so have u rent ur clothes? let him come now 2 me, N he shall know dat there is a prophet in Israel.
So Naaman came wit his horses N wit his chariot, N stood at tha door of tha house of Elisha.
N Elisha sent a messenger 2 him, sayin, Go N wash in Jordan seven times, N ur flesh shall come again 2 u, N u will be clean.
But Naaman was angry, N went away, N said, look, I thought, He will surely come out 2 me, N stand, N call on tha name of tha LORD his God, N strike his hand over tha place, N recover tha leper.
R not Abana N Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all tha waterz of Israel? may I not wash in ’em, N be clean? So he turned N went away in a rage.
N his servants came near, N spoke 2 him, N said, My father, if tha prophet had bid u do some great thing, would u not have done it? how much rather then, when he says 2 u, Wash, N be clean?
Then went he down, N dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according 2 tha sayin of tha man of God: N his flesh came again like 2 tha flesh of a little child, N he was clean.

N he returned 2 tha man of God, he N all his company, N came, N stood before him: N he said, look, now I know dat there is no God in all tha earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray u, take a blessing of ur servant.
But he said, As tha LORD lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none. N he urged him 2 take it; but he refused.
N Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray u, be given 2 ur servant two mules’ burden of earth? 4 ur servant will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice 2 other gods, but 2 tha LORD.

In dis thing tha LORD pardon ur servant, dat when my master goes in2 tha house of Rimmon 2 worship there, N he leaneth on my hand, N I bow myself in tha house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in tha house of Rimmon, tha LORD pardon ur servant in dis thing.
N he said 2 him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.

But Gehazi, tha servant of Elisha tha man of God, said, look, my master has spared Naaman dis Syrian, in not receivin at his hands dat which he brought: but, as tha LORD lives, I will run after him, N take somewhat of him.
So Gehazi followed after Naaman. N when Naaman saw him runnin after him, he lighted down from tha chariot 2 meet him, N said, Is all well?

N he said, All is well. My master has sent me, sayin, look, even now there be come 2 me from mount Ephraim two young men of tha sons of tha prophets: give ’em, I pray u, a talent of silver, N two changes of garments.
N Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. N he urged him, N bound two talents of silver in two bags, wit two changes of garments, N laid ’em upon two of his servants; N dey bare ’em before him.
N when he came 2 tha tower, he took ’em from their hand, N bestowed ’em in tha house: N he let tha men go, N dey departed.
But he went in, N stood before his master. N Elisha said 2 him, from where come u, Gehazi? N he said, ur servant went no where.

N he said 2 him, Went not mine heart wit u, when tha man turned again from his chariot 2 meet u? Is it a time 2 receive money, N 2 receive garments, N oliveyards, N vineyards, N sheep, N oxen, N menservants, N maidservants?
Tha leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave 2 u, N 2 ur seed 4 ever. N he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.

6.text: N tha sons of tha prophets said 2 Elisha, look now, tha place where we live wit u is too strait 4 us.
Let us go, we pray u, 2 Jordan, N take thence every man a beam, N let us make us a place there, where we may live. N he answered, Go y’all.
N one said, Be content, I pray u, N go wit ur servants. N he answered, I will go.
So he went wit ’em. N when dey came 2 Jordan, dey cut down wood.
But as one was felling a beam, tha axe head fell in2 tha water: N he cried, N said, Alas, master! 4 it was borrowed.
N tha man of God said, Where fell it? N he showed him tha place. N he cut down a stick, N cast it in there; N tha iron did swim.
Therefore said he, Take it up 2 u. N he put out his hand, N took it.
Then tha king of Syria warred against Israel, N took counsel wit his servants, sayin, In such N such a place shall be my camp.
N tha man of God sent 2 tha king of Israel, sayin, Beware dat u pass not such a place; 4 there tha Syrians r come down.
N tha king of Israel sent 2 tha place which tha man of God told him N warned him of, N saved himself there, not once nor twice.
Therefore tha heart of tha king of Syria was sore troubled 4 dis thing; N he called his servants, N said 2 ’em, Will y’all not show me which of us is 4 tha king of Israel?
N one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, tha prophet dat is in Israel, tells tha king of Israel tha words dat u speak in ur bedchamber.
N he said, Go N spy where he is, dat I may send N fetch him. N it was told him, sayin, look, he is in Dothan.
Therefore sent he there horses, N chariots, N a great host: N dey came by night, N compassed tha city about.
N when tha servant of tha man of God was risen early, N gone forth, look, an host compassed tha city both wit horses N chariots. N his servant said 2 him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?
N he answered, don’t fear: 4 dey dat be wit us r more than dey dat be wit ’em.

N Elisha prayed, N said, LORD, I pray u, open his eyes, dat he may see. N tha LORD opened tha eyes of tha young man; N he saw: N, look, tha mountain was full of horses N chariots of fire round about Elisha.
N when dey came down 2 him, Elisha prayed 2 tha LORD, N said, strike dis people, I pray u, wit blindness. N he struck ’em wit blindness according 2 tha word of Elisha.
N Elisha said 2 ’em, dis is not tha way, neither is dis tha city: follow me, N I will bring u 2 tha man whom y’all seek. But he led ’em 2 Samaria.
N it happened, when dey were come in2 Samaria, dat Elisha said, LORD, open tha eyes of dese men, dat dey may see. N tha LORD opened their eyes, N dey saw; N, look, dey were in tha midst of Samaria.
N tha king of Israel said 2 Elisha, when he saw ’em, My father, shall I strike ’em? shall I strike ’em?
N he answered, u will not strike ’em: would u strike dose whom u have taken captive wit ur sword N wit ur bow? set bread N water before ’em, dat dey may eat N drink, N go 2 their master.
N he prepared great provision 4 ’em: N when dey had eaten N drunk, he sent ’em away, N dey went 2 their master. So tha bands of Syria came no more in2 tha land of Israel.
N it happened after dis, dat Ben-hadad king of Syria gathered all his host, N went up, N besieged Samaria.
N there was a great famine in Samaria: N, look, dey besieged it, until an ass’s head was sold 4 fourscore pieces of silver, N tha fourth part of a cab of dove’s dung 4 five pieces of silver.
N as tha king of Israel was passing by upon tha wall, there cried a woman 2 him, sayin, Help, my lord, O king.
N he said, If tha LORD do not help u, from where shall I help u? out of tha barnfloor, or out of tha winepress? save u
N tha king said 2 her, What ails u? N she answered, dis woman said 2 me, Give ur son, dat we may eat him 2 day, N we will eat my son 2 morrow.
So we boiled my son, N did eat him: N I said 2 her on tha next day, Give ur son, dat we may eat him: N she has hid her son.
N it happened, when tha king heard tha words of tha woman, dat he rent his clothes; N he passed by upon tha wall, N tha people looked, N, look, he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.
Then he said, God do so N more also 2 me, if tha head of Elisha tha son of Shaphat shall stand on him dis day.

But Elisha sat in his house, N tha elders sat wit him; N tha king sent a man from before him: but ere tha messenger came 2 him, he said 2 tha elders, See y’all how dis son of a murderer has sent 2 take away mine head? look, when tha messenger comes, shut tha door, N hold him fast at tha door: is not tha sound of his master’s feet behind him?
N while he yet talked wit ’em, look, tha messenger came down 2 him: N he said, look, dis evil is of tha LORD; what should I wait 4 tha LORD any longer?

7.text: Then Elisha said, Hear y’all tha word of tha LORD; like dis says tha LORD, 2 morrow about dis time shall a measure of fine flour be sold 4 a shekel, N two measures of barley 4 a shekel, in tha gate of Samaria.

u sayest, (but dey r but vain words,) I have counsel N strength 4 tha war. Now on whom do u trust, dat u rebellest against me?
Now, look, u trust upon tha staff of dis bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go in2 his hand, N pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt 2 all dat trust on him.

But if y’all say 2 me, We trust in tha LORD our God: is not dat he, whose high places N whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, N has said 2 Judah N Jerusalem, y’all shall worship before dis altar in Jerusalem?
Now therefore, I pray u, give pledges 2 my lord tha king of Assyria, N I will deliver u two thousand horses, if u be able on ur part 2 set riders upon ’em.
How then will u turn away tha face of one captain of tha least of my master’s servants, N put ur trust on Egypt 4 chariots N 4 horsemen?
Am I now come up without tha LORD against dis place 2 destroy it? tha LORD said 2 me, Go up against dis land, N destroy it.

Then said Eliakim tha son of Hilkiah, N Shebna, N Joah, 2 Rab-shakeh, Speak, I pray u, 2 ur servants in tha Syrian language; 4 we understand it: N talk not wit us in tha Jews’ language in tha ears of tha people dat r on tha wall.

But Rab-shakeh said 2 ’em, has my master sent me 2 ur master, N 2 u, 2 speak dese words? has he not sent me 2 tha men which sit on tha wall, dat dey may eat their own dung, N drink their own piss wit u?
Then Rab-shakeh stood N cried wit a loud voice in tha Jews’ language, N spoke, sayin, Hear tha word of tha great king, tha king of Assyria:
Like dis says tha king, don’t let Hezekiah deceive u: 4 he shall not be able 2 deliver u out of his hand:
Neither let Hezekiah make u trust in tha LORD, sayin, tha LORD will surely deliver us, N dis city shall not be delivered in2 tha hand of tha king of Assyria.

Listen not 2 Hezekiah: 4 like dis says tha king of Assyria, Make an agreement wit me by a present, N come out 2 me, N then eat y’all every man of his own vine, N every one of his fig tree, N drink y’all every one tha waterz of his cistern:

Until I come N take u away 2 a land like ur own land, a land of corn N wine, a land of bread N vineyards, a land of oil olive N of honey, dat y’all may live, N not die: N listen not 2 Hezekiah, when he persuadeth u, sayin, tha LORD will deliver us.
Has any of tha gods of tha nations delivered at all his land out of tha hand of tha king of Assyria?
Where r tha gods of Hamath, N of Arpad? where r tha gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, N Ivah? have dey delivered Samaria out of mine hand?
Who r dey among all tha gods of tha countries, dat have delivered their country out of mine hand, dat tha LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?
But tha people held their peace, N answered him not a word: 4 tha king’s commandment was, sayin, Answer him not.
Then came Eliakim tha son of Hilkiah, which was over tha household, N Shebna tha scribe, N Joah tha son of Asaph tha recorder, 2 Hezekiah wit their clothes rent, N told him tha words of Rab-shakeh.

19.text: N it happened, when king Hezekiah heard it, dat he rent his clothes, N covered himself wit sackcloth, N went in2 tha house of tha LORD.
N he sent Eliakim, which was over tha household, N Shebna tha scribe, N tha elders of tha priests, covered wit sackcloth, 2 Isaiah tha prophet tha son of Amoz.
N dey said 2 him, like dis says Hezekiah, dis day is a day of trouble, N of rebuke, N blasphemy: 4 tha children r come 2 tha birth, N there is not strength 2 bring forth.

It may be tha LORD ur God will hear all tha words of Rab-shakeh, whom tha king of Assyria his master has sent 2 reproach tha livin God; N will reprove tha words which tha LORD ur God has heard: so lift up ur prayer 4 tha remnant dat r left.
So tha servants of king Hezekiah came 2 Isaiah.
N Isaiah said 2 ’em, like dis shall y’all say 2 ur master, like dis says tha LORD, don’t be afraid of tha words which u have heard, wit which tha servants of tha king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
Look, I will send a blast upon him, N he shall hear a rumour, N shall return 2 his own land; N I will cause him 2 fall by tha sword in his own land.
So Rab-shakeh returned, N found tha king of Assyria warring against Libnah: 4 he had heard dat he was departed from Lachish.
N when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, look, he is come out 2 fight against u: he sent messengers again 2 Hezekiah, sayin,
Like dis shall y’all speak 2 Hezekiah king of Judah, sayin, don’t let ur God in whom u trust deceive u, sayin, Jerusalem shall not be delivered in2 tha hand of tha king of Assyria.
Look, u have heard what tha kings of Assyria have done 2 all lands, by destroying ’em utterly: N will u be delivered?
Have tha gods of tha nations delivered ’em which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, N Haran, N Rezeph, N tha children of Eden which were in Thelasar?
Where is tha king of Hamath, N tha king of Arpad, N tha king of tha city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, N Ivah?
N Hezekiah received tha letter of tha hand of tha messengers, N read it: N Hezekiah went up in2 tha house of tha LORD, N spread it before tha LORD.
N Hezekiah prayed before tha LORD, N said, O LORD God of Israel, which dwell between tha cherubims, u r tha God, even u alone, of all tha kingdoms of tha earth; u have made heaven N earth.
LORD, bow down thine ear, N hear: open, LORD, ur eyes, N see: N hear tha words of Sennacherib, which has sent him 2 reproach tha livin God.
Of a truth, LORD, tha kings of Assyria have destroyed tha nations N their lands,
N have cast their gods in2 tha fire: 4 dey were no gods, but tha work of men’s hands, wood N stone: therefore dey have destroyed ’em.
Now therefore, O LORD our God, I beg u, save u us out of his hand, dat all tha kingdoms of tha earth may know dat u r tha LORD God, even u only.
Then Isaiah tha son of Amoz sent 2 Hezekiah, sayin, like dis says tha LORD God of Israel, dat which u have prayed 2 me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.
Dis is tha word dat tha LORD has spoken concerning him; tha virgin tha daughter of Zion has despised u, N laughed u 2 scorn; tha daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at u.
Whom have u reproached N blasphemed? N against whom have u exalted ur voice, N lifted up ur eyes on high? even against tha Holy One of Israel.

By ur messengers u have reproached tha Lord, N have said, wit tha crowd of my chariots I am come up 2 tha height of tha mountains, 2 tha sides of Lebanon, N will cut down tha tall cedar trees of it, N tha choice fir trees of it: N I will enter in2 tha lodgings of his borders, N in2 tha forest of his Carmel.
I have digged N drunk strange waterz, N wit tha sole of my feet have I dried up all tha rivers of besieged places.
Have u not heard long ago how I have done it, N of ancient times dat I have formed it? now have I brought it 2 pass, dat u should be 2 lay waste fenced citiez in2 ruinous heaps.

Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, dey were dismayed N confounded; dey were as tha grass of tha field, N as tha green herb, as tha grass on tha housetops, N as corn blasted before it be grown up.
But I know ur stayed, N ur goin out, N ur comin in, N ur rage against me.
Because ur rage against me N ur tumult is come up in2 mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in ur nose, N my bridle in ur lips, N I will turn u back by tha way by which u came.

N dis shall be a sign 2 u, y’all shall eat dis year such things as grow of themselves, N in tha second year dat which springeth of tha same; N in tha third year sow y’all, N reap, N plant vineyards, N eat tha fruits of it.
N tha remnant dat is escaped of tha house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, N bear fruit upward.
4 out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, N dey dat escape out of mount Zion: tha zeal of tha LORD of hosts shall do dis.
Therefore like dis says tha LORD concerning tha king of Assyria, He shall not come in2 dis city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it wit shield, nor cast a bank against it.
By tha way dat he came, by tha same shall he return, N shall not come in2 dis city, says tha LORD.
4 I will defend dis city, 2 save it, 4 my own sake, N 4 my servant David’s sake.

N it happened dat night, dat tha angel of tha LORD went out, N struck in tha camp of tha Assyrians an hundred fourscore N five thousand: N when dey arose early in tha morning, look, dey were all dead corpses.
So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, N went N returned, N lived at Nineveh.

N it happened, as he was worshippin in tha house of Nisroch his god, dat Adrammelech N Sharezer his sons struck him wit tha sword: N dey escaped in2 tha land of Armenia. N Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.

20.text: In dose days was Hezekiah sick 2 death. N tha prophet Isaiah tha son of Amoz came 2 him, N said 2 him, like dis says tha LORD, Set thine house in order; 4 u will die, N not live.
Then he turned his face 2 tha wall, N prayed 2 tha LORD, sayin,
I beg u, O LORD, remember now how I have walked before u in truth N wit a perfect heart, N have done dat which is good in ur sight. N Hezekiah wept sore.
N it happened, afore Isaiah was gone out in2 tha middle court, dat tha word of tha LORD came 2 him, sayin,

Turn again, N tell Hezekiah tha captain of my people, like dis says tha LORD, tha God of David ur father, I have heard ur prayer, I have seen ur tears: look, I will heal u: on tha third day u will go up 2 tha house of tha LORD.
N I will add 2 ur days fifteen years; N I will deliver u N dis city out of tha hand of tha king of Assyria; N I will defend dis city 4 my own sake, N 4 my servant David’s sake.
N Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. N dey took N laid it on tha boil, N he recovered.
N Hezekiah said 2 Isaiah, What shall be tha sign dat tha LORD will heal me, N dat I shall go up in2 tha house of tha LORD tha third day?
N Isaiah said, dis sign will u have of tha LORD, dat tha LORD will do tha thing dat he has spoken: shall tha shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?
N Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing 4 tha shadow 2 go down ten degrees: no, but let tha shadow return backward ten degrees.
N Isaiah tha prophet cried 2 tha LORD: N he brought tha shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in tha dial of Ahaz.
At dat time Berodach-baladan, tha son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters N a present 2 Hezekiah: 4 he had heard dat Hezekiah had been sick.

N Hezekiah listened 2 ’em, N showed ’em all tha house of his precious things, tha silver, N tha gold, N tha spices, N tha precious ointment, N all tha house of his armour, N all dat was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, dat Hezekiah showed ’em not.
Then came Isaiah tha prophet 2 king Hezekiah, N said 2 him, What said dese men? N from from where came dey 2 u? N Hezekiah said, dey r come from a far country, even from Babylon.
N he said, What have dey seen in thine house? N Hezekiah answered, All tha things dat r in mine house have dey seen: there is nothing among my treasures dat I have not showed ’em.
N Isaiah said 2 Hezekiah, Hear tha word of tha LORD.
Look, tha days come, dat all dat is in thine house, N dat which ur fathers have laid up in store 2 dis day, shall be carried in2 Babylon: nothing shall be left, says tha LORD.
N of ur sons dat shall issue from u, which u will beget, shall dey take away; N dey shall be eunuchs in tha palace of tha king of Babylon.
Then said Hezekiah 2 Isaiah, Good is tha word of tha LORD which u have spoken. N he said, Is it not good, if peace N truth be in my days?
N tha rest of tha acts of Hezekiah, N all his might, N how he made a pool, N a conduit, N brought water in2 tha city, r dey not written in tha book of tha chronicles of tha kings of Judah?
N Hezekiah slept wit his fathers: N Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

21.text: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began 2 reign, N reigned fifty N five years in Jerusalem. N his mother’s name was Hephzi-bah.
N he did dat which was evil in tha sight of tha LORD, after tha abominations of tha heathen, whom tha LORD cast out before tha children of Israel.

4 he built up again tha high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; N he reared up altars 4 Baal, N made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; N worshipped all tha host of heaven, N served ’em.
N he built altars in tha house of tha LORD, of which tha LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.
N he built altars 4 all tha host of heaven in tha two courts of tha house of tha LORD.
N he made his son pass through tha fire, N observed times, N used enchantments, N dealt wit familiar spirits N wizards: he wrought much wickedness in tha sight of tha LORD, 2 provoke him 2 anger.

N he set a graven image of tha grove dat he had made in tha house, of which tha LORD said 2 David, N 2 Solomon his son, In dis house, N in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name 4 ever:

Neither will I make tha feet of Israel move any more out of tha land which I gave their fathers; only if dey will observe 2 do according 2 all dat I have commanded ’em, N according 2 all tha law dat my servant Moses commanded ’em.
But dey listened not: N Manasseh seduced ’em 2 do more evil than did tha nations whom tha LORD destroyed before tha children of Israel.
N tha LORD spoke by his servants tha prophets, sayin,
Because Manasseh king of Judah has done dese abominations, N has done wickedly above all dat tha Amorites did, which were before him, N has made Judah also 2 sin wit his idols:
Therefore like dis says tha LORD God of Israel, look, I am bringin such evil upon Jerusalem N Judah, dat whoever hears of it, both his ears shall tingle.
N I will stretch over Jerusalem tha line of Samaria, N tha plummet of tha house of Ahab: N I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, N turnin it upside down.
N I will forsake tha remnant of mine inheritance, N deliver ’em in2 tha hand of their opps; N dey shall become a prey N a spoil 2 all their opps;
Because dey have done dat which was evil in my sight, N have provoked me 2 anger, since tha day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even 2 dis day.

Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end 2 another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah 2 sin, in doin dat which was evil in tha sight of tha LORD.
Now tha rest of tha acts of Manasseh, N all dat he did, N his sin dat he sinned, r dey not written in tha book of tha chronicles of tha kings of Judah?
N Manasseh slept wit his fathers, N was buried in tha garden of his own house, in tha garden of Uzza: N Amon his son reigned in his stead.
Amon was twenty N two years old when he began 2 reign, N he reigned two years in Jerusalem. N his mother’s name was Meshullemeth, tha daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
N he did dat which was evil in tha sight of tha LORD, as his father Manasseh did.
N he walked in all tha way dat his father walked in, N served tha idols dat his father served, N worshipped ’em:
N he forsook tha LORD God of his fathers, N walked not in tha way of tha LORD.
N tha servants of Amon conspired against him, N killed tha king in his own house.
N tha people of tha land killed all ’em dat had conspired against king Amon; N tha people of tha land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
Now tha rest of tha acts of Amon which he did, r dey not written in tha book of tha chronicles of tha kings of Judah?
N he was buried in his sepulchre in tha garden of Uzza: N Josiah his son reigned in his stead.

22.text: Josiah was eight years old when he began 2 reign, N he reigned thirty N one years in Jerusalem. N his mother’s name was Jedidah, tha daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.
N he did dat which was right in tha sight of tha LORD, N walked in all tha way of David his father, N turned not aside 2 tha right hand or 2 tha left.
N it happened in tha eighteenth year of king Josiah, dat tha king sent Shaphan tha son of Azaliah, tha son of Meshullam, tha scribe, 2 tha house of tha LORD, sayin,
Go up 2 Hilkiah tha high priest, dat he may sum tha silver which is brought in2 tha house of tha LORD, which tha keepers of tha door have gathered of tha people:

N let ’em deliver it in2 tha hand of tha doers of tha work, dat have tha oversight of tha house of tha LORD: N let ’em give it 2 tha doers of tha work which is in tha house of tha LORD, 2 repair tha breaches of tha house,
2 carpenters, N builders, N masons, N 2 buy timber N hewn stone 2 repair tha house.
But there was no reckoning made wit ’em of tha money dat was delivered in2 their hand, because dey dealt faithfully.
N Hilkiah tha high priest said 2 Shaphan tha scribe, I have found tha book of tha law in tha house of tha LORD. N Hilkiah gave tha book 2 Shaphan, N he read it.

N Shaphan tha scribe came 2 tha king, N brought tha king word again, N said, ur servants have gathered tha money dat was found in tha house, N have delivered it in2 tha hand of ’em dat do tha work, dat have tha oversight of tha house of tha LORD.
N Shaphan tha scribe showed tha king, sayin, Hilkiah tha priest has delivered me a book. N Shaphan read it before tha king.
N it happened, when tha king had heard tha words of tha book of tha law, dat he rent his clothes.
N tha king commanded Hilkiah tha priest, N Ahikam tha son of Shaphan, N Achbor tha son of Michaiah, N Shaphan tha scribe, N Asahiah a servant of tha king’s, sayin,

Go y’all, enquire of tha LORD 4 me, N 4 tha people, N 4 all Judah, concerning tha words of dis book dat is found: 4 great is tha wrath of tha LORD dat is kindled against us, because our fathers have not listened 2 tha words of dis book, 2 do according 2 all dat which is written concerning us.

So Hilkiah tha priest, N Ahikam, N Achbor, N Shaphan, N Asahiah, went 2 Huldah tha prophetess, tha wife of Shallum tha son of Tikvah, tha son of Harhas, keeper of tha wardrobe; (now she lived in Jerusalem in tha college;) N dey communed wit her.
N she said 2 ’em, like dis says tha LORD God of Israel, Tell tha man dat sent u 2 me,
Like dis says tha LORD, look, I will bring evil upon dis place, N upon tha inhabitants of it, even all tha words of tha book which tha king of Judah has read:

Because dey have forsaken me, N have burned incense 2 other gods, dat dey might provoke me 2 anger wit all tha works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against dis place, N shall not be quenched.
But 2 tha king of Judah which sent u 2 enquire of tha LORD, like dis shall y’all say 2 him, like dis says tha LORD God of Israel, As touching tha words which u have heard;

Because thine heart was tender, N u have humbled urself before tha LORD, when u heard what I spoke against dis place, N against tha inhabitants of it, dat dey should become a desolation N a curse, N have rent ur clothes, N wept before me; I also have heard u, says tha LORD.
Look therefore, I will gather u 2 ur fathers, N u will be gathered in2 ur grave in peace; N ur eyes shall not see all tha evil which I will bring upon dis place. N dey brought tha king word again.

23.text: N tha king sent, N dey gathered 2 him all tha elders of Judah N of Jerusalem.

N tha king went up in2 tha house of tha LORD, N all tha men of Judah N all tha inhabitants of Jerusalem wit him, N tha priests, N tha prophets, N all tha people, both small N great: N he read in their ears all tha words of tha book of tha covenant which was found in tha house of tha LORD.

N tha king stood by a pillar, N made a covenant before tha LORD, 2 walk after tha LORD, N 2 keep his commandments N his testimonies N his statutes wit all their heart N all their soul, 2 perform tha words of dis covenant dat were written in dis book. N all tha people stood 2 tha covenant.

N tha king commanded Hilkiah tha high priest, N tha priests of tha second order, N tha keepers of tha door, 2 bring forth out of tha temple of tha LORD all tha vessels dat were made 4 Baal, N 4 tha grove, N 4 all tha host of heaven: N he burned ’em without Jerusalem in tha fields of Kidron, N carried tha ashes of ’em 2 Beth-el.

N he put down tha idolatrous priests, whom tha kings of Judah had ordained 2 burn incense in tha high places in tha citiez of Judah, N in tha places round about Jerusalem; ’em also dat burned incense 2 Baal, 2 tha sun, N 2 tha moon, N 2 tha planets, N 2 all tha host of heaven.

N he brought out tha grove from tha house of tha LORD, without Jerusalem, 2 tha brook Kidron, N burned it at tha brook Kidron, N stamped it small 2 powder, N cast tha powder of it upon tha graves of tha children of tha people.
N he broke down tha houses of tha sodomites, dat were by tha house of tha LORD, where tha women wove hangings 4 tha grove.

N he brought all tha priests out of tha citiez of Judah, N defiled tha high places where tha priests had burned incense, from Geba 2 Beer-sheba, N broke down tha high places of tha gates dat were in tha entering in of tha gate of Joshua tha governor of tha city, which were on a man’s left hand at tha gate of tha city.
Nevertheless tha priests of tha high places came not up 2 tha altar of tha LORD in Jerusalem, but dey did eat of tha unleavened bread among their brothers.
N he defiled Topheth, which is in tha valley of tha children of Hinnom, dat no man might make his son or his daughter 2 pass through tha fire 2 Molech.

N he took away tha horses dat tha kings of Judah had given 2 tha sun, at tha entering in of tha house of tha LORD, by tha chamber of Nathan-melech tha chamberlain, which was in tha suburbs, N burned tha chariots of tha sun wit fire.

N tha altars dat were on tha top of tha upper chamber of Ahaz, which tha kings of Judah had made, N tha altars which Manasseh had made in tha two courts of tha house of tha LORD, did tha king beat down, N broke ’em down from thence, N cast tha dust of ’em in2 tha brook Kidron.

N tha high places dat were before Jerusalem, which were on tha right hand of tha mount of corruption, which Solomon tha king of Israel had builded 4 Ashtoreth tha abomination of tha Zidonians, N 4 Chemosh tha abomination of tha Moabites, N 4 Milcom tha abomination of tha children of Ammon, did tha king defile.
N he broke in pieces tha images, N cut down tha groves, N filled their places wit tha bones of men.

Moreover tha altar dat was at Beth-el, N tha high place which Jeroboam tha son of Nebat, who made Israel 2 sin, had made, both dat altar N tha high place he broke down, N burned tha high place, N stamped it small 2 powder, N burned tha grove.

N as Josiah turned himself, he spied tha sepulchres dat were there in tha mount, N sent, N took tha bones out of tha sepulchres, N burned ’em upon tha altar, N polluted it, according 2 tha word of tha LORD which tha man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed dese words.

Then he said, What title is dat dat I see? N tha men of tha city told him, It is tha sepulchre of tha man of God, which came from Judah, N proclaimed dese things dat u have done against tha altar of Beth-el.
N he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So dey let his bones alone, wit tha bones of tha prophet dat came out of Samaria.

N all tha houses also of tha high places dat were in tha citiez of Samaria, which tha kings of Israel had made 2 provoke tha Lord 2 anger, Josiah took away, N did 2 ’em according 2 all tha acts dat he had done in Beth-el.
N he killed all tha priests of tha high places dat were there upon tha altars, N burned men’s bones upon ’em, N returned 2 Jerusalem.
N tha king commanded all tha people, sayin, Keep tha passover 2 tha LORD ur God, as it is written in tha book of dis covenant.
Surely there was not holden such a passover from tha days of tha judges dat judged Israel, nor in all tha days of tha kings of Israel, nor of tha kings of Judah;
But in tha eighteenth year of king Josiah, in which dis passover was holden 2 tha LORD in Jerusalem.

Moreover tha workers wit familiar spirits, N tha wizards, N tha images, N tha idols, N all tha abominations dat were spied in tha land of Judah N in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, dat he might perform tha words of tha law which were written in tha book dat Hilkiah tha priest found in tha house of tha LORD.

N like 2 him was there no king before him, dat turned 2 tha LORD wit all his heart, N wit all his soul, N wit all his might, according 2 all tha law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.
Even so tha LORD turned not from tha fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all tha provocations dat Manasseh had provoked him withal.
N tha LORD said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, N will cast off dis city Jerusalem which I have chosen, N tha house of which I said, My name shall be there.
Now tha rest of tha acts of Josiah, N all dat he did, r dey not written in tha book of tha chronicles of tha kings of Judah?
In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against tha king of Assyria 2 tha river Euphrates: N king Josiah went against him; N he killed him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

N his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, N brought him 2 Jerusalem, N buried him in his own sepulchre. N tha people of tha land took Jehoahaz tha son of Josiah, N anointed him, N made him king in his father’s stead.
Jehoahaz was twenty N three years old when he began 2 reign; N he reigned three months in Jerusalem. N his mother’s name was Hamutal, tha daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
N he did dat which was evil in tha sight of tha LORD, according 2 all dat his fathers had done.
N Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in tha land of Hamath, dat he might not reign in Jerusalem; N put tha land 2 a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, N a talent of gold.
N Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim tha son of Josiah king in tha room of Josiah his father, N turned his name 2 Jehoiakim, N took Jehoahaz away: N he came 2 Egypt, N died there.

N Jehoiakim gave tha silver N tha gold 2 Pharaoh; but he taxed tha land 2 give tha money according 2 tha commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted tha silver N tha gold of tha people of tha land, of every one according 2 his taxation, 2 give it 2 Pharaoh-nechoh.
Jehoiakim was twenty N five years old when he began 2 reign; N he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. N his mother’s name was Zebudah, tha daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
N he did dat which was evil in tha sight of tha LORD, according 2 all dat his fathers had done.

24.text: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, N Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned N rebelled against him.

N tha LORD sent against him bands of tha Chaldees, N bands of tha Syrians, N bands of tha Moabites, N bands of tha children of Ammon, N sent ’em against Judah 2 destroy it, according 2 tha word of tha LORD, which he spoke by his servants tha prophets.
